race.comment: MAN OF WORTH (6) excellent return in a high rating contest with a tough third to Cross Tasman over 1400m at this track in BM88 company. Maps well and has the right profile to put these away. GALLANT STAR (1) tough old gelding who had no luck first ip in The Kosciuszko over 1200m here when ninth. Claim helps from the right draw and ready for this trip. FLYING BANDIT (3) handy stayer who ran third in the LR Wagga Wagga Cup last May. Warmed up late on resumption with a tidy fifth to Perisher over 1500m at Rosehill in BM88 class. His good second up record keeps him in the conversation. ROCK EMPIRE (4) comes here off a 31-day let-up and gets the services of Nash Rawiller today. Jumped in grade with a plodding ninth in a BM94 at this track over 1600m. Improver.
